book.name: 2 Jön
book.title: 2 Jön Jöntho bapiya ngo Duichon suraro auha irim togoc

content: Noc amna dugo, nocho bapiya ngo Duichon surarohon managum-bocni sontha yongo irim tat. Kopotorocho son inoha erang figoc. Noc sontha toup sinom kombihat. O nakagon muno, owi amna ambarac Kopotorochon mata boinno kombingidangma yu ambaracho sontha toup kombingidang.
Kopotorochon mata boinnoho wömai nonidec iditacmaho bongono muno nonot edengoc. Worocha tongga non sontha toup kombingidamon.

Kopotoroc Nandöng noni orin yuhon Manano Yesu Duic yuho nontha uroci kombingga ning banangmunya irot noni tu guc mauna ogepgon itnahamon. Tongo non Kopotorochon irot imoc imoc kiapdec irot tungu singmanaina mata boinno kokorengga iditnahamon.
Non muyu irot noni nuc noniha bogingmanaina itongitnahamon

Noc kaya sonthon suraro sonidecma owi amna au yu Kopotorochon mata boinno kokorengmuya itongidang. Nandöng noni yu ‘ihoroc tongitnahamon’ yongo nongoru nimogoc. Worocha wömai nocho son kangmaina irot ogep moröma sinom kombihat.

Nakain suraro sinom, nocho nongoru wego au makanit. Muno, nongoru osucgon sogidomonma worocgon kantiwa. Woi ingoroc: Non muyu irot noni oröc noniha tong fup imongo nucnoha toup kombiun kombiun tongo itongitnahamon.

Irot imoc imoc kiap boinno wömai ingoroc: Non Kopotorochon nongoru sumbotmanaina itongitnahamon. Oro yuhon nongoru woi woroc, son nuc soniha toup kombingmuya itongitnung. Nongoru wo wömai sonu osucgon kombigung.
Imanang fandat fandat amna koböcmaho non tonguc necnecha kombiang

Boinno sinom, tonguc yecyec amna koböcmaho guroc ngocin itongidang. Yuho wömai yongidang, Yesu Duic yu guroc amna sinom maöngkuboc. Oro amna ihorocno yui Duichon ayamo idang, yui mata imanang yongga son tonguc keckecha kombiang.

Son soni woho, Duicha tongga son yapmu ogepma sogidung. Tongo son acacho itongitnung. Yapmu ogepma wo gorong ongicyit. Son muyu acacho itonguya Kopotorocho soniin youp sonihon wöngnacno ambarac kamongdup tangoc.
Amna au yu mata Duicho fandat nimogocma wo fodiantacma yu wömai Kopotorochon amna maec. Wohong amna au yu Duichon nongoru kokorengmuna itongitacma yu wömai Nandöng orin Manano yuhon amna sinom itac.
Oro, amna au yu sonot engmuna Duicho mata fandadidocma worocotma yu mafandat kanunai wömai sonu amna wo soni bucin yangat töninga, o yuot oröc toninga.
Amna auho amna ihorocnot oröc tontacma yu wömai yuhon youp wömuno imongtoc tuna worochon turongo yudec entac.
Amna dugo yu suraro acacha kombigoc

Oro, nocho mata koböcma son kanoc kanocha kombihat mahong noc ngo bapiyadec irim toctocha kombiaya angit maec. Muno, noc sonot engga yangam soni yangmaina mata wo kanoc kanocha kombihat. Ihoroc tongo non ambaracho borongdetno sinom tonahamon.
Suraro au yu Kopotorocho inoha erang figocma yui irot ogep matano sontha siuya ongeyac. Worocgon.
